collection_sources: pinned model cards and technical reports
versioned harness repositories and recorded run settings

buckets.model: Collect static documented attributes; preserve identity uncertainty.
buckets.abilities: Fit from training-only outcomes with out-of-fold features and support counts.
buckets.harness_run: Separate supported functionality from actually enabled tools, prompting, sampling and budgets.
buckets.task: Ground estimated skills, language, modality and constraints in exact task spans; leave empirical difficulty null.
buckets.compatibility: Derive from reviewed system and task fields; unknown does not imply mismatch.
buckets.evidence: Construct disjoint training-only support/query episodes; exclude query outcomes from inputs.
